name: Polaroid

influenced_by: Edwin Land's instant-film technology (introduced 1948, color from 1963)

eras: 1948–present (with a 2008 near-discontinuation and 2010s relaunch under the Impossible Project/Polaroid Originals)
garments: not a fashion look — a photographic format
reacts_against: nothing — instant film's specific chemistry produces a soft-contrast, slightly color-shifted look (often cooler highlights, warmer shadows) that became a nostalgic aesthetic reference once digital and smartphone cameras made the format mostly obsolete for practical use.
revivals: actively relaunched as a product (Polaroid Originals, since renamed back to Polaroid) and widely imitated by digital filters

findings: mostly muted — about 60% of the measured color is low-saturation (greys, dusty tones)
measured.caveat: Colors measured from Wikimedia Commons images as photographed and displayed on screen; actual materials vary, and screen colors are approximate.
